name: Mebuki College
description: Mebuki College is a calm, typography-led block theme for early-childhood teacher-training colleges, nurseries and schools. The home page opens on a pale split hero: the headline and two buttons at the left beside one documentary photograph at the right with a tutor's white chalk marks drawn over it, and three dated cards docked over the photo foot. It continues with notched photo cards carrying vertical labels, a placement day on one hairline, two mirrored panel cards with a scooped corner and round arrow disc, three routes, a full-width fee sheet, admission steps, a tutor list and graduate quotes. Fraunces and Source Sans 3, high-key documentary photography, quiet scroll effects.
